request.style: English, male baritone solo with backing choir, electric guitar, bass, drums, cymbals, deep and reverent mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Seventy-four of the sons of Hodaviah
Returned from Babylon under the sky
With Zerubbabel and Joshua we came
To rebuild the house of the Lord

[Pre-Chorus]
Kadmiel with his sons stood together
To oversee those working on the holy place
The foundation laid with care and reverence
Priests in vestments with trumpets raised

[Chorus]
Stand up and bless the LORD your God
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
Which is exalted above every praise

[Verse]
On the platform of the Levites
Kadmiel cried out with a loud voice
We recalled the sins of our fathers
And the history of our days
You chose Abram from Ur of the Chaldeans
And gave him a new name

[Chorus]
Stand up and bless the LORD your God
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
Which is exalted above every praise

[Bridge]
We placed our seal upon the covenant
To follow the law and commandments
The wall is finished and the praise is sung
Our descendants join in the song

[Chorus]
Stand up and bless the LORD your God
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
Which is exalted above every praise

[Outro]
Blessed be your glorious name
Above every blessing and praise
